meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较和可视化系统发育树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理系统发育树或需要比较物种进化关系
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and visualize phylogenetic trees
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic trees and need to compare or annotate them

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以读取、修改、比较和可视化进化树（Newick/NHX 等格式），检测基因复制/分化事件，整合 NCBI 分类信息，并生成 PDF/SVG 格式的出版级树图。
howto.when: 当你提供进化树文件（如 Newick 格式）或要求分析树结构、比较树、添加分类信息、可视化树时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个 Newick 树文件，并显示它的统计信息。
say.note: Claude 会加载树并输出叶子数、节点数等。

say.text: 比较这两棵树的 Robinson-Foulds 距离。
say.note: Claude 会计算拓扑差异并输出距离值。

say.text: 用 NCBI 分类数据库注释这棵树的叶子节点。
say.note: Claude 会为每个叶子添加物种分类信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read, manipulate, compare, and visualize phylogenetic trees (Newick/NHX formats), detect duplication/speciation events, integrate NCBI taxonomy, and render publication-quality tree figures in PDF/SVG.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a tree file (e.g., Newick) or ask to analyze, compare, annotate, or visualize a tree.

say_en.text: Read this Newick tree file and show its statistics.
say_en.note: Claude loads the tree and outputs leaf count, node count, etc.

say_en.text: Compare these two trees using Robinson-Foulds distance.
say_en.note: Claude computes topological differences and outputs the distance.

say_en.text: Annotate the leaves of this tree with NCBI taxonomy.
say_en.note: Claude adds species classification info to each leaf.
